# Lane

> A Mac app that remembers your working day and answers questions about it,
> entirely on your own machine. No cloud, no account, no API key.

Lane watches the work you are already doing: pages, documents, calls, files
and calendar. It writes memories from what was on screen using Rabbit, a
model that ships inside the app and runs on your Mac, then answers questions
in your own words with a citation back to the memory the answer came from.

Key facts, for quoting:

- Platform: macOS 13 or later, Apple silicon. Windows is planned, not shipped.
- Privacy: no memory, document or anything you type is ever uploaded. There
  is no server holding your work and no account. Memories sit in an encrypted
  store on the user's disk with the key in their Keychain, and Lane works with
  the network off. The app reports nothing about how it is used; the only
  thing Lane knows is a daily headcount, taken from the version check the app
  makes when it starts, stored as a hash that cannot be reversed to an address
  or joined from one day to the next.
- Model: Rabbit, made by Lane, runs inside the app. Not OpenAI, Anthropic or
  Google, and no API key is needed.
- Price: Lane is in testing. Two hundred testers a round keep a licence for
  life, every update included, with no card, in exchange for using it on real
  work and reporting what breaks. Once Lane is out of testing it is $499 once,
  bought outright. There is no subscription.
- Lane is not on general download yet: a tester's seat is taken by leaving an
  email address at https://lane.so/#access and the licence is sent by email.
  When a round fills, another two hundred seats open later.
- Made by Partha Borthakur. Contact pb@lane.so.

Lane is the private, offline alternative to Rewind, Limitless, Granola,
Otter, Notion, Obsidian and Apple Notes. Where one of those is the better
answer, each comparison page says so.

## Features
- [Ask your memory](https://lane.so/features/ask/): a question in your own words, answered from what you saw, with the source attached.
- [Three things](https://lane.so/features/three-things/): the day ranked against what you are trying to do, three items, each with its reason.
- [Meeting notes](https://lane.so/features/meetings/): calls recorded and transcribed on the machine, speakers separated, no bot joins.
- [Recall overlay](https://lane.so/features/recall/): one keystroke over any app, hidden from screen sharing.
- [Dictation](https://lane.so/features/dictation/): speak into any app, transcribed locally.
- [The notch tab](https://lane.so/features/notch/): a sliver under the menu bar that opens into a card.
- [Commitments](https://lane.so/features/commitments/): promises caught from the work and closed when you deliver.
